```{r}
#| message: false

.libPaths(c("~/Rlibs", .libPaths()))
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
hist_file <- "pedestrian_counts_processed.csv"
new_files <- sprintf("%d_Pedestrian_Data.csv", 2022:2025)

new <- rbindlist(lapply(new_files, fread), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
new[, sensing_date := as.Date(Sensing_Date)]
new[, year := as.integer(format(sensing_date, "%Y"))]
new[, month := as.integer(format(sensing_date, "%m"))]
new[, dow := as.integer(format(sensing_date, "%u"))]

coords <- new[, .(lat = mean(Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
                  lon = mean(Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)), by = Location_ID]

hist <- fread(hist_file, select = c("sensing_date", "location_id", "pedestriancount",
                                    "year", "month",
                                    "covid_phase", "mega_event", "is_public_holiday"))
hist[, sensing_date := as.Date(sensing_date)]
hist[, dow := as.integer(format(sensing_date, "%u"))]
```

## RQ5: post-COVID change by location

```{r}
hist_day <- hist[year >= 2015 & year <= 2019,
                 .(daily = sum(as.numeric(pedestriancount))),
                 by = .(location_id, sensing_date, year, month)]

baseline <- hist_day[, .(base = median(daily, na.rm = TRUE),
                         yrs = uniqueN(year)),
                     by = .(location_id, month)]
baseline <- baseline[yrs >= 3]

new_day <- new[year >= 2024,
               .(daily = sum(as.numeric(PedestrianCount))),
               by = .(Location_ID, sensing_date, month)]
good <- new_day[, .N, by = Location_ID][N >= 200, Location_ID]

recent <- new_day[Location_ID %in% good,
                  .(recent = median(daily, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  by = .(Location_ID, month)]

chg <- baseline[recent, on = .(location_id = Location_ID, month = month), nomatch = 0]
chg[, pct := recent / base * 100 - 100]

loc <- chg[, .(change = median(pct, na.rm = TRUE), n = .N), by = location_id]
loc <- loc[n >= 3]
loc <- merge(loc, coords, by.x = "location_id", by.y = "Location_ID")
setorder(loc, change)
loc[, sensor := factor(location_id, levels = location_id)]
```

```{r}
ggplot(loc, aes(lon, lat, colour = change)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#d73027", mid = "grey92", high = "#1a9850",
                         midpoint = 0, labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(title = "Where Melbourne has recovered vs where it has not",
       subtitle = "2024-25 median daily counts vs same-month 2015-19 baseline",
       x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Change vs\npre-COVID") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r}
ggplot(loc, aes(change, sensor)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = change, yend = sensor,
                   colour = change >= 0), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = change >= 0), size = 2.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1a9850", "FALSE" = "#d73027"),
                      labels = c("TRUE" = "Recovered", "FALSE" = "Still down")) +
  labs(title = "Post-COVID change by sensor",
       x = "Change vs pre-COVID baseline (%)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
```

## RQ6: unusually busy and quiet days

```{r}
h_city <- hist[, .(d = sum(as.numeric(pedestriancount))),
               by = .(location_id, sensing_date, year, month, dow)]
h_city <- h_city[, .(city = median(d, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 by = .(sensing_date, year, month, dow)]

n_city <- new[, .(d = sum(as.numeric(PedestrianCount))),
               by = .(Location_ID, sensing_date, year, month, dow)]
n_city <- n_city[, .(city = median(d, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 by = .(sensing_date, year, month, dow)]

h_city <- h_city[sensing_date <= as.Date("2022-11-14")]
n_city <- n_city[sensing_date > as.Date("2022-11-14")]

city <- rbindlist(list(h_city, n_city), use.names = TRUE)
city <- city[!is.na(city) & city > 0]

cal <- city[year <= 2019, .(exp = median(city, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(month, dow)]
city <- merge(city, cal, by = c("month", "dow"))
city[, resid := city - exp]
```

```{r}
flags <- hist[, .(mega = any(mega_event), hol = any(is_public_holiday),
                  ph = covid_phase[1]),
              by = .(sensing_date = as.Date(sensing_date))]
city <- merge(city, flags, by = "sensing_date", all.x = TRUE)

busy_new <- city[year >= 2022][order(-resid)][1:8, sensing_date]
busy_old <- city[year <= 2019][order(-resid)][1:4, sensing_date]
quiet    <- city[order(resid)][1:10, sensing_date]

city[, type := "normal"]
city[sensing_date %in% busy_new, type := "recent_busy"]
city[sensing_date %in% busy_old, type := "old_busy"]
city[sensing_date %in% quiet, type := "quiet"]

city[, lab := ""]
city[type == "recent_busy" & mega == TRUE, lab := "mega event"]
city[type == "recent_busy" & mega == FALSE & hol == TRUE, lab := "holiday"]
city[type == "recent_busy" & lab == "", lab := format(sensing_date, "%Y-%m-%d")]
city[type == "old_busy" & mega == TRUE, lab := "mega event"]
city[type == "old_busy" & lab == "", lab := format(sensing_date, "%Y-%m-%d")]
city[type == "quiet" & !is.na(ph) & ph != "Normal", lab := ph]
city[type == "quiet" & lab == "", lab := format(sensing_date, "%Y-%m-%d")]

covid <- city[!is.na(ph) & ph != "Normal", range(sensing_date)]
```

```{r}
ggplot(city, aes(sensing_date, resid)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = covid[1], xmax = covid[2],
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = city[type == "recent_busy"], colour = "#d73027", size = 2.2) +
  geom_point(data = city[type == "old_busy"], colour = "#e6550d", size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = city[type == "quiet"], colour = "#2166ac", size = 2.2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = city[type != "normal"], aes(label = lab),
                  size = 2.6, max.overlaps = 20,
                  min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)) +
  labs(title = "Days unusually busy or quiet vs calendar-adjusted expectation",
       subtitle = "Red: busiest 2022-25   Orange: pre-COVID peaks   Blue: lockdown days",
       x = NULL, y = "Median sensor count minus expectation") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```
